description: This Perl module, DiffHighlight.pm, provides functionality for highlighting diff output by reversing foreground and background colors, detecting diff hunks, and managing colorized output. It appears to be a utility script used for visual diff highlighting, likely integrated into a larger diff or version control tooling setup.

methods.name: visible_width
methods.description: Calculates the visible width of a string by excluding terminal color sequences.

methods.name: visible_substr
methods.description: Returns a substring of the input string omitting a specified number of visible characters, ignoring color sequences.

methods.name: handle_line
methods.description: Processes each line of diff input, manages highlighting, and queues additions and removals.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Flushes queued diff hunks for display.

methods.name: highlight_stdin
methods.description: Reads standard input line by line, processes diff lines for highlighting.

methods.name: color_config
methods.description: Retrieves color configuration from git config, or defaults if not available.

methods.name: show_hunk
methods.description: Displays a diff hunk with proper highlighting of changes.

methods.name: highlight_pair
methods.description: Highlights matching and differing parts of a pair of diff lines.

methods.name: split_line
methods.description: Splits a diff line into components, separating color sequences.

methods.name: highlight_line
methods.description: Highlights parts of a line based on theme, managing color application.

methods.name: is_pair_interesting
methods.description: Determines if a pair of lines has significant differences worth highlighting.
